Tom — thanks, great context. Happy to coordinate. Two quick thoughts:

- Option A (joint): 09:00 AM ET / 15:00 CET — early for US but within EU working hours.
- Option B (late joint): 04:00 PM ET / 10:00 PM CET — works for your NYC team but risks going past EU engineers' day.

Because of the upcoming DST transitions (US and EU shift dates don't line up), I'm trying to avoid any one-off calendar surprises. I'm looping in Laura (Berlin-based SE) to confirm EU engineering availability; Marcus is on to approve any late-hour coverage if needed.

If neither option looks good, we often do a staggered flow: 30–40 minute joint overview at a mutually tolerable time, then a 20–30 minute deep dive for EU engineers with recording for your APAC folks. I attached a quick agenda (brookline-demo-agenda.pdf) and a lightweight network diagram.

Proposed next steps: you pick A/B or say yes to the staggered approach and we'll send a calendar invite with explicit timezone notes.
